# ChristmasFun.store

> Printable Christmas downloads delivered instantly by email and printed at home, including Santa letters, Christmas notes, seasonal kits, a Christmas planner, themed printable collections, personalized ornaments, and free coloring pages.

ChristmasFun.store sells digital Christmas products for families, teachers, and grandparents. Purchased files are delivered by email after checkout. Nothing is shipped.

## Santa Letters

- [Santa Letters](https://christmasfun.store/#designs): Twenty printable Santa letter designs with spaces for a child's name, age, behavior, and wish list. Price: $0.99 each.

## Christmas Notes

- [Christmas Notes](https://christmasfun.store/#christmas-notes): Four printable Christmas note designs for short holiday messages and gifts. Price: $2.99 for the set of four.

## Teacher License

- [Teacher License](https://christmasfun.store/#teachers): A one time classroom license for unlimited classroom printing of all 24 Christmas Classics designs. Price: $4.99.

## Christmas Classics Bundle

- [Christmas Classics Bundle](https://christmasfun.store/#bundle): All 20 Santa Letters and all 4 Christmas Notes in one printable bundle. Price: $9.99.

## The 24 Day Elf Kit

- [The 24 Day Elf Kit](https://christmasfun.store/#elf-kit): A 78 page printable kit with elf letters, 24 daily notes, tiny cards, games, props, seals, envelopes, and a staging calendar for December elf fun. Launch price: $7.99 through December 1, 2026, then $9.99.

## Christmas Memory Night Kit

- [Christmas Memory Night Kit](https://christmasfun.store/#memory-night): A 43 page printable kit for a hosted family memory night, with games, conversation cards, a photo scavenger hunt, recipes, and keepsake pages. Launch price: $11.99 through December 1, 2026, then $14.99.

## The Christmas Heirloom Planner

- [The Christmas Heirloom Planner](https://christmasfun.store/#heirloom-planner): A 67 page printable planner with gift lists, fillable gift and budget forms, a reusable auto date calendar, an Excel gift and budget tracker, menus, calendars, and keepsake pages. Launch price: $9.99 through December 1, 2026, then $14.99.

## Nutcrackercore

- [Nutcrackercore](https://christmasfun.store/#nutcrackercore): A Nutcracker themed printable collection with storybook wall art, party printables, a personalized ornament, and a Sugar Plum cocoa bar set. Prices: individual products from $1.99; Full Collection $9.99.

## Personalized Ornaments

- [Personalized Ornaments](https://christmasfun.store/#personalized): Editable printable ornament designs for couples, babies, pets, families, and gingerbread name tags. Prices: products priced individually.

## Gothmas

- [Gothmas](https://christmasfun.store/#gothmas): A dark, elegant printable Christmas collection with ornaments, gothic winter wall art, greeting cards, gift tags and wrap, and countdown cards. Prices: products priced individually.

## Free Coloring Pages

- [Free Coloring Pages](https://christmasfun.store/#adult-coloring): Ten detailed printable Christmas coloring pages. Price: free.

## Store Information

- Website: https://christmasfun.store/
- Delivery: Digital files delivered by email after checkout.
- Printing: Designed for printing at home, primarily on US Letter paper unless a product states another size.
- Support: ChristmasMagicDesigns@juldd.com
